definitions.explanation: A person, team, or entity that competes with another on a similar level. Unlike the purely negative English connotation, ライバル in Japanese often implies a respected opponent who pushes one to improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ライバルだ。
ライバル{会社|がいしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: The competition with rival companies is fierce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ライバルがいた⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was because I had a rival since childhood that I was able to grow this far.

notes:
ライバル is a loanword from English "rival." In Japanese usage, it often carries a positive or respectful nuance — a worthy opponent who brings out the best in you.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ライバル{会社|がいしゃ} / ライバル⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (rival company)
- ライバル⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (rival relationship)
- ライバル{意識|いしき} (sense of rivalry, competitive spirit)
- ライバル{心|しん} (competitive spirit)
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ライバル (eternal rival)
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧ライバル (a good rival)

USAGE:
- In manga and anime, ライバル is a key character archetype — the rival who pushes the protagonist forward
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧ライバル (a good rival) is a common expression showing the positive Japanese view of rivalry
- The native equivalent {競争相手|きょうそうあいて} is more neutral and businesslike
